sentences.en: Chemical companies are waiting until everything dies down before reinvesting.
sentences.zh: 化学公司要等一切平静下来才会重新投资。

sentences.en: How much money have they reinvested in the community?
sentences.zh: 他们有多少资金重新投入到社区中？

sentences.en: The company decided to reinvest profits into research and development.
sentences.zh: 该公司决定将利润再投资于研发。
